raw_confidence.description: The highest softmax probability from the raw model output.

calibrated_confidence.description: The confidence after temperature scaling (if Tier 3). Otherwise equals raw_confidence.

uncertainty.description: The epistemic uncertainty (variance from MC-Dropout). Evaluated in Tiers 1-3. Falls back to entropy if MC-Dropout variance is uncomputable.

ood_score.description: The Mahalanobis distance from the nearest class centroid. Null in Tiers 1 and 2.

ood_threshold.description: The dynamically fitted threshold above which an image is considered OOD. Null in Tiers 1 and 2.

layers_run.description: List of safety layers that successfully executed (e.g., ['temperature_scaling', 'mc_dropout', 'mahalanobis']).
